title: 4 Affordable Care Act Marketplace plans from UnitedHealthcare
summary: Article describing four UnitedHealthcare Individual & Family ACA Marketplace plan types, Essential, Value, Advantage and Copay Focus, with premium and deductible levels and who each may suit.

atoms.title: Four UnitedHealthcare ACA plan types
atoms.question: What types of ACA Marketplace plans does this article describe?
atoms.text: Everyone has different health care needs, so UnitedHealthcare Individual & Family ACA Marketplace plans come in several plan types to fit your lifestyle and budget. This article describes four types: Essential, Value, Advantage and Copay Focus, each with its own mix of premium and deductible.
questions: What are the UnitedHealthcare ACA plan types?
How do I choose among ACA plan types?

atoms.title: The Essential plan
atoms.question: What is the UnitedHealthcare Essential ACA plan?
atoms.text: The Essential plan is a high-deductible plan with basic coverage for serious illness or injury, shown as premium $ and deductible $$$$. You pay a lower monthly premium but more when you get care, so it fits people who rarely see a provider but want a low-cost way to protect against worst-case scenarios. Essential plans are available only at the Bronze metal level and only when shopping off-exchange directly from UnitedHealthcare or through a licensed insurance agent.

Who is a high-deductible Bronze plan good for?

atoms.title: The Value plan
atoms.question: What is the UnitedHealthcare Value ACA plan?
atoms.text: The Value plan is shown as premium $$ and deductible $$. It offers a low or even $0 monthly premium, a moderate deductible, and a mix of copays and coinsurance when you get care. Some Value plans offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) option. It may fit people who see a provider regularly and want more benefits covered than an Essential plan, and it is available in all markets on all metal levels.

Can I get a $0 premium on a Value plan?

atoms.title: The Advantage plan
atoms.question: What is the UnitedHealthcare Advantage ACA plan?
atoms.text: The Advantage plan is shown as premium $$$ and deductible $. You invest in a higher monthly premium to benefit from a lower deductible, pay manageable copays for many services, and reach your low deductible faster. It is a good match if you see your provider often and are willing to pay a little more each month to pay less when you get care. Advantage plans are available in most markets on Silver and Gold metal levels.
questions: Which ACA plan has a low deductible?
Are Advantage plans available in Silver and Gold?

atoms.title: The Copay Focus plan
atoms.question: What is the UnitedHealthcare Copay Focus ACA plan?
atoms.text: Copay Focus plans are shown as premium $$$$ with no deductible. They are designed to help you know what your care may cost before you head to the provider. You pay a moderate premium and have a $0 medical deductible, so the plan begins to pay its portion from day one, and you pay fixed copays when you get care. A deductible may apply for some prescription drug benefits. Copay Focus plans are available in all metal levels.

atoms.title: Qualifying for a $0 monthly premium
atoms.question: What is required to get a $0 monthly premium?
atoms.text: The article notes that to qualify for a $0 monthly premium you must meet household income requirements for Advanced Premium Tax Credits. It mentions a low or even $0 monthly premium in connection with Value plans.
